_comment: Base module — every other module inherits from this one unless it declares a different `extends`. Role `core` means it's editable in the editor but hidden from the play picker; the canonical record set lives here and child modules override by record id. See web/src/data_model/StaticModuleSource.ts for the merge semantics.
title: Default Module
description: The base module — canonical effects, classes, races, items, monsters, etc. Other modules extend this one and override records by id.
author: Matt
